purpose: First smoke run — verify the harness end to end before committing compute to the full VulnLoc set.
local_modifications: baselines/san2patch/0001-add-claude-haiku-4-5.patch — all four of San2Patch's stock Anthropic model IDs are retired (HTTP 404), so a current model had to be registered before it could reach Anthropic at all.
host_caveat: Box was under load ~8.6/8 cores from the AutoSec pipeline throughout. Timing here is a lower bound on speed, not a measurement — do not compare it to the paper's 8m55s average.
notes: CVE-2017-14745 could not be run: it is the ONLY one of the 66 cases in the benchmark image whose src/ tree is absent, so validation could not start. Packaging gap on their side, present since the image was built (2025-06-19), not caused by our run. Excluded from the denominator rather than scored as a failure.
The image ships 41 of the 43 VulnLoc cases (no ffmpeg) plus 25 San2Vuln = 66.
